title: Kissed Tender Venezuelan Tofu Bowl
description: A tangy and tender Venezuelan dish featuring miso-marinated tofu in a dolsot stone bowl, made with semi-skimmed milk and jain-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Whisk together miso paste, semi-skimmed milk, rice vinegar, and a pinch of salt in a large bowl.
Add the cubed tofu to the marinade and mix gently to coat.
Let the tofu marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the marinade and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the tofu with olive oil and sprinkle with black pepper.
Bake the tofu in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Prepare the dolsot stone bowls by heating them in the oven for 5 minutes.
Serve the baked tofu over cooked white rice in the heated stone bowls.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
